boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Connecticut, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented to campus, finding activity options, and sampling UConn’s public cultural and recreation spaces.

cards.title: Start at the Student Union
cards.subtitle: 2110 Hillside Road, Storrs
cards.notes: Use the Information Center and building directory to orient yourself, then look over posted programming before choosing the rest of your day.
cards.short_summary: A practical first indoor stop for campus information and services.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn lists the Student Union at 2110 Hillside Road and identifies an Information Center and building directory for visitors.
cards.source_title: Student Union and Event Services | University of Connecticut
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Union’s current hours and any event-specific access details before visiting.

cards.title: Save the Involvement Fair for your club-search pass
cards.subtitle: Fairfield Way, Storrs campus
cards.notes: When the recurring fair is scheduled, walk Fairfield Way and ask a few organizations about meetings, beginner access, and how to join.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus event for meeting student organizations in one place.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn describes the Involvement Fair as its largest free event and says it brings together more than 500 student organizations and university programs.
cards.access_notes: This is a scheduled recurring event; consult the official page for the next date and location.

cards.title: Make Homer Babbidge your reset point
cards.subtitle: 369 Fairfield Way, Storrs
cards.notes: Take a short break in the main library, then note its study, printing, tutoring, scanning, and technology-help resources for later.
cards.short_summary: The main Storrs library combines study space with academic-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn calls Homer Babbidge Library the intellectual, learning, cultural, and social hub for its main campus and lists study, printing, tutoring, and technology services.
cards.source_title: Homer Babbidge Library Hours | UConn Library
cards.access_notes: After 8 p.m., including 24-hour study spaces, access requires a UConn ID card swipe.

cards.title: Tour the Student Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: 2060 Hillside Road, Storrs
cards.notes: Bring your UConn ID, take a first look at the facility, and choose one approachable option such as a court, pool, track, or climbing wall.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation facility with varied indoor activity spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn says all students have access to the Student Recreation Center, which includes fitness equipment, a climbing wall, two pools, and gym courts.
cards.access_notes: Bring a UConn ID and check current facility hours, reservations, and activity policies before arriving.

cards.title: Browse the Benton’s galleries
cards.subtitle: 245 Glenbrook Road, Storrs
cards.notes: Set aside a quiet gallery loop, then use the current-exhibitions information to pick one work or theme to discuss with a friend.
cards.short_summary: UConn’s campus art museum offers rotating exhibitions and free gallery admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Benton is Connecticut’s State art museum on the UConn Storrs campus, and its official visitor page states that gallery admission is free.
cards.source_title: Hours & Admission | William Benton Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Current gallery hours are Tuesday–Friday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 1–4 p.m.; check for closures before visiting.

cards.title: Book a free planetarium show
cards.subtitle: UConn Storrs campus
cards.notes: Reserve a public-show ticket in advance, arrive a little early, and use the show as a calm evening activity with a clear start and finish.
cards.short_summary: A renovated campus planetarium that runs regular public shows.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn states that the planetarium reopened in 2024, runs regular Monday and Wednesday morning public shows, and requires a free ticket.
cards.source_title: Cynthia Wyeth Peterson Memorial Planetarium | UConn Physics
cards.access_notes: Public shows require a free ticket; confirm the current schedule and sign-up availability on the official page.

cards.title: Add a Dairy Bar stop
cards.subtitle: 17 Manter Road, Storrs
cards.notes: Choose a treat or browse the UConn-made dairy products, then pair the stop with a walk around the nearby Horsebarn Hill landscape.
cards.short_summary: A campus retail shop selling ice cream and other UConn dairy products.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Dining says the Dairy Bar opened in 1953 to sell products made by the UConn Creamery and is located at 17 Manter Road.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists daily 11 a.m.–9 p.m. hours, subject to seasonal and holiday changes.

cards.title: Take in Horsebarn Hill from public areas
cards.subtitle: UConn Storrs campus
cards.notes: Walk or pause at publicly accessible viewpoints near the hill, enjoy the agricultural landscape, and follow all posted boundaries around farm operations.
cards.short_summary: A working-farm landscape central to UConn’s agricultural identity.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn describes Horsebarn Hill as an iconic Storrs campus feature and a working farm supporting education, extension, and research.
cards.source_title: Home on Horsebarn Hill | UConn Today
cards.access_notes: View from public areas only; the hill includes active agricultural and research operations, so respect posted signs and restricted areas.

cards.entity_name: Ballard Institute and Museum of Puppetry
cards.title: Cross into Downtown Storrs for the Ballard
cards.subtitle: 1 Royce Circle, Suite 101B, Storrs
cards.notes: Explore the puppetry displays at your own pace, then check the museum calendar for any family-friendly programs that match your weekend.
cards.short_summary: A UConn puppetry museum in Downtown Storrs with pay-what-you-wish admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ballard Institute lists its location at 1 Royce Circle in Storrs and says its suggested $5 donation is pay-what-you-wish.
cards.source_title: Plan a Visit | Ballard Institute and Museum
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Wednesday–Sunday hours; verify hours and any program details before the trip.

cards.entity_name: Jorgensen Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Check what is on at Jorgensen
cards.subtitle: 2132 Hillside Road, Storrs
cards.notes: Look over the season schedule, choose a performance that fits your budget and timing, and use the box office for current ticket information.
cards.short_summary: A public campus performing-arts venue with an auditorium, theater, and gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn identifies Jorgensen as a public performing arts venue on the Storrs campus with a 2,300-seat auditorium, 500-seat theater, and gallery.
cards.source_title: About | Jorgensen Center for the Performing Arts
cards.access_notes: Performance admission and schedules vary; consult the official season schedule or box office before making plans.
